sentences.text: My name is Emily, and I'm so happy
to have you here with me today.
In today's episode, we're gonna talk about fashion.
Fashion is a topic that many people enjoy talking about.
It's important to know how to talk about clothes,
styles, and trends in English.
Whether you are shopping for clothes,
discussing your favorite styles,
or talking about what others are wearing,
knowing the right words and phrases is helpful.
Let's get started.
Part one, important vocabulary for fashion.
First, let's go over some important words related to fashion.
I will say each word slowly, and you can repeat after me.
Fashion, the style of clothing that is popular
at a particular time.
Clothes, the items you wear such as shirts, pants, dresses,
etcetera.
Outfit, a set of clothes that you wear together.
Trend, a popular style that is in fashion at the moment.
Accessories, items that you wear to complete your outfit
such as hats, jewelry, scarves, and shoes.
Designer, a person who creates fashion items,
especially high-end clothing.
Casual, clothes that are comfortable and not too formal.
Formal, clothes that are appropriate for special or professional events.
Comfortable, clothes that are easy to wear and feel good.
Stylish, clothing that looks fashionable and is well put together.
Part two, useful phrases for talking about fashion.
Now let's learn some useful phrases to talk about fashion.
I will say each phrase twice.
Listen carefully and repeat after me.
What are you wearing today?
A common question to ask someone about their outfit.
I like your outfit.
A compliment to someone about their clothing.
This dress is beautiful.
A compliment about a dress.
I'm looking for something casual to wear when you want comfortable clothes.
I need something more formal for a party.
When you need clothes for a special event.
These shoes go well with my outfit.
Talking about matching shoes with clothes.
I love your style.
A compliment about someone's fashion sense.
I'm not sure if this shirt is my style.
When you are unsure about your taste in clothing.
I like to wear bright colors.
Talking about your color preferences.
This jacket is very stylish.
Complementing someone's fashionable outerwear.
Three, describing what you are wearing.
Let's talk about how to describe your own clothes.
Here are some sentences you can practice.
I'm wearing a blue t-shirt and jeans.
Describing a simple outfit.
I have on a black dress and red shoes.
Describing a more formal look.
I'm wearing a cozy sweater because it's cold today.
Talking about clothes for the weather.
I'm wearing a suit for the meeting.
Describing formal clothes for work or a special occasion.
I have a casual outfit today because I'm going to the park.
Describing your outfit for a relaxed day.
I'm wearing my favorite sneakers.
Talking about shoes.
I'm wearing a jacket because it's windy.
Describing your clothes for specific weather.
I like to wear dresses in the summer.
Talking about your favorite types of clothing.
Part four.
It's also common to ask questions about fashion.
Here are some examples.
What do you think of my outfit?
Asking for someone's opinion on your clothes.
Do you like my shoes?
Asking about specific clothing items.
Is this style and fashion right now?
Asking if a particular style is trendy.
Where did you buy that dress?
Asking where someone got their clothing.
Can you recommend a good place to buy clothes?
Asking for shopping advice.
What's the fashion trend this season?
Asking about the current trends.
Do you follow fashion trends?
Asking if someone likes to wear the latest styles.
Part five.
Talking about fashion trends.
In fashion trends change over time.
Let's learn some phrases to talk about fashion trends.
This year the trend is oversized jackets.
Talking about a current fashion trend.
I love the trend of wearing bright colors this season.
Talking about your favorite trend.
High waisted jeans are very popular right now.
Mentioning a popular fashion item.
People are wearing a lot of vintage clothing these days.
Talking about a style that has come back.
Everyone is wearing sneakers with dresses now.
Talking about a trend in footwear and clothing combinations.
I think this trend will be popular next year.
Predicting a future fashion trend.
Many people are wearing leather jackets this fall.
Talking about a seasonal trend.
Part six.
Common fashion problems.
Sometimes fashion can be tricky.
Let's look at some common fashion problems and how to talk about them.
My clothes don't fit anymore.
When your clothes are too big or too small.
I don't have anything to wear.
When you feel like you don't have enough clothes for an event.
These shoes are too tight.
Talking about uncomfortable footwear.
I can't decide what to wear.
When you have trouble choosing an outfit.
My clothes are out of style.
When you feel like your wardrobe is not trendy anymore.
I need a new wardrobe.
When you want to update your clothing collection.
I'm not sure if this color suits me.
When you're unsure about wearing a particular color.
I don't know how to match clothes.
When you need help putting outfits together.

Fashion.
Clothes.

You can listen to this episode again to improve your
